title: PING ExternalAgentAdapter Result envelope v1
description: Result envelope returned by the exterior agent. PING validates it before recording WORKER_COMPLETED or WORKER_FAILED through the canonical event runtime. Validation failure is non-retryable.

work_order_id.description: Must echo the issued work_order_id exactly.

context_pack_id.description: Must echo the ContextPack identity authorized by the issued WorkOrder exactly.

agent_id.description: Self-declared agent identity; PING cross-checks it against the invoked agent.

capability.description: Must echo the capability authorized by the issued work order.

evidence.description: Agent-reported evidence (timing/host may be added by PING).
